Tangential anecdote on "how to ask permission":

A monk was craving cigarettes, so he went to ask the Abbot if he was allowed to smoke while praying. The Abbot, somewhat miffed, rebuked the monk for even asking.

A few weeks later the monk walked past the room of another monk and saw him smoking while kneeling and quietly whispering prayers. He went in and asked how the monk got permission to smoke?

The monk paused in his prayers, looked at his colleague thoughtfully, then said "I went to the Abbot and asked if it was acceptable for me to pray while I smoked."
